findings.issue: Self-approval bypass when workflow_requester is None
findings.description: verify_not_self_approved falls back to comparing approved_by != requester_id when workflow_requester is None. If workflow_requester was never stored and requester_id is empty (the default), the method returns True (not self-approved) even when it is.
findings.recommendation: Store workflow_requester at approval creation time or remove the fallback and fail-closed when the field is missing.

findings.description: When candidate_sha256, manifest_id, or manifest_sha256 parameters are empty strings (the default), the function skips those checks entirely and returns (True, ''). This allows transition without hash verification.
findings.recommendation: Make hash parameters required or return (False, 'missing verification parameters') when critical hashes are omitted.

findings.issue: No expiry mechanism despite authorization checker documentation
findings.description: approval_checker.py docstring states 'Must not be expired (if expiry exists in approval model)' but ImplementationApproval has no expiry field or validation.
findings.recommendation: Either implement expiry (approval timestamp + TTL) or remove the reference from the authorization contract.
